PKCE and registering the Entra ID app
Connecting Claude Desktop, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
The fabric model, multi-LLM and the 2027 trajectory

takeaways: The remote streamable HTTP endpoint of the Dataverse MCP server replaces local STDIO proxies and scales to many agents and LLM clients through one governed endpoint.
PKCE with an Entra ID app registration, an environment allow list and correct redirect URIs lets Claude and GitHub Copilot authenticate without any client secret.
Existing Dataverse roles, row and field level security, business rules, confirmation flags and audit trails keep agent actions governed and traceable.
hook: Still wiring a local proxy to connect AI tools to Dataverse? This episode shows Power Platform architects and developers why the remote Dataverse MCP endpoint, secured with PKCE and Entra ID, turns Dataverse into a governed, multi-LLM backbone for Claude, GitHub Copilot and custom agents.
